name: normalModel
meaning: Main-model snapshot (ScnObject_InitWithAltModels outMain), restored by Mine_Reset when the exploded model is showing

name: explodedModel
meaning: Alternate model from id-list 3 (the shared explosion model, same list as Dynamite); swapped in by Mine_SetState(4)

name: deadline
meaning: g_gameTime deadline. SetState(1): now + 0x5000 (5 s). SetState(3): now + 0x2aa (0.1665 s). GroundMine proximity trigger: now + fuseDelay. DefusableMine state 5: now + 0x14000 (20 s). DefusableMine_Reset: now

name: savedPos
meaning: Position after SnapToGround in Mine_Init; msg 0x13 refreshes it while in world; Mine_Reset restores it

name: mineFlags
meaning: bit 0 = explodedModel is shown (set by SetState(4), cleared by Mine_Init/Mine_Reset); DefusableMine skips its idle animation while it is set
